units.source_text: 但是自从河童国回来以后，约莫过了一年的时间，

en.t: But after I returned from the land of the kappa, about a year passed,

units.source_text: 我因为一桩事业失败了……

en.t: and I failed in a certain enterprise...

units.source_text: （他刚讲到这，S博士就打断他说：“先不要谈这个了。”

en.t: (Just as he had said this much, Dr. S interrupted him and said, "Let us not talk about that for now."

units.source_text: 据博士所言，他每次谈到这件事，就闹得看护人也手足无措。）

en.t: According to the doctor, whenever he spoke of this matter, he caused even the attendants to be at a loss.)
